title: Goldschmidt 2027 Conference
institution: European Association of Geochemistry (EAG) and the Geochemical Society
level: Researchers and students (open call for abstracts)
about: The Goldschmidt 2027 Conference, co-organised by the European Association of Geochemistry and the Geochemical Society, takes place 11 to 16 July 2027 in Paris, France. Abstract submission opens in December 2026 and closes 25 February 2027.
